errors.evidence: The statement that all TDNN-HMM values are 'close to or slightly above 30%' is incorrect. The values for Test3 (~26.5%), Test4 (~27.5%), and Test5 (~28.5%) are clearly below 30% and not particularly close to it.

errors.text_span: EDR 值在 22% 至 25% 之间
errors.evidence: The EDR value for DNN-HMM in Test3 is approximately 20%, which is outside the stated range of '22% to 25%'. The actual range is approximately 20% to 24.5%.
The EDR value for LSTM-HMM in Test1 is approximately 10.5%, which is outside the stated range of '12% to 18%'. The actual combined range for these two models is approximately 10.5% to 18.5%.
